body.style: Technical, precise, highly readable in dense layouts

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-slate-50
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-slate-100

background.description: Deep Slate (Tinted dark gray, avoiding pure black)

glassmorphism.usage: Sticky Headers, Floating Navs, Modal Overlays, and Tooltips
glassmorphism.classes: bg-slate-900/60 backdrop-blur-xl backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)]
glassmorphism.rule: NEVER use a fully transparent background. Glassmorphism must feel like milled crystal—smooth and distinct.

dashboard_cards.classes: bg-[#131722] border border-white/5 shadow-sm rounded-xl overflow-hidden

grids_and_layouts.strategy: High Density Grid (For Dashboards) - The Bento Grid Protocol

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: MUST explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white). Button lifts slightly (-translate-y-1).
motion_and_interaction.focus_states: MUST have HIGHER contrast. focus:ring-2 focus:ring-amber-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#0B0F19]
motion_and_interaction.transitions: transition-colors transition-transform duration-200 ease-out (DO NOT use 'transition-all')

components.general: Use Shadcn components for logic, but customize styling heavily to fit the MSME luxury/modern dark theme.
components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). Solid Gold/Amber for primary CTAs. Glass/outline for secondary.
components.inputs: Flat solid background (bg-[#0B0F19]) inside cards, with 1px border. Focus state glows with Slate Blue or Amber.
components.navigation: Always visible on desktop. Use Glassmorphism for fixed top nav. Sidebar uses flat solid dark.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Ensure text over gradients or images has drop shadows.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-button').
accessibility.focus: Keyboard navigation must show distinct focus rings.

image_urls.description: Concentric rings of blue and purple liquid paint for abstract data/tech visualization.
A dark modern desk with a computer, setting an MSME professional tone.
Blue and purple background with small dots representing data streams.

3d_libraries_and_charts.charts: Use Shadcn Charts (Recharts under the hood). Customize tooltips with the glassmorphism classes.
3d_libraries_and_charts.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard tooling. Clean and professional.

instructions_to_main_agent: NOTE: You have .js files, NOT .tsx files. Share the guideline for .js files. For example, use sonner.js instead of sonner.tsx.
Install required fonts (@fontsource/cabinet-grotesk, @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans) or load via Google Fonts/CDN.
Setup Tailwind config with the specified dark theme palette (base #0B0F19, surface #131722, amber/blue highlights).
Build the dashboard using the Bento Grid Protocol for modular widgets.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glassmorphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) specifically for floating elements.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). This breaks transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). This disrupts human reading flow.
Always use modern button styles with hover/active interactions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like robot, brain, lightbulb) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
NEVER use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. Only use the provided media URLs.
